newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $166 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $166 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold a total of 9.010 billion shillings ($166 million) of treasury bills at the weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.

Out of these, the bank sold 8.971 billion shillings of the main 91-day category at an average yield of 20.149 percent compared to 11.052 billion shillings at an average yield of 20.298 percent last week.

In the 28-day category, it sold 39 million shillings at 16.5 percent unchanged. Last week, it sold 128 million shillings of the same category. The bank invited tenders for seven billion shillings of t-bills for the next week's auction on Thursday.
